履修条件
Persons who conduct their own research project for a master's/doctoral degree.
授業概要
Throughout the master's and doctoral courses, you will develop the knowledge and skills necessary to undertake independent research at the forefront of your field. This course teaches you how to develop your research skills practically. Hence, the lecture is composed of general talks on scientific skills and your tailored case study, which is based on your own MD or PhD research project. The scope of the lecture covers not only deepening your research study but also considers how to develop the research project into practical applications, such as a product or service, and even a start-up. The lecture obviously demands that you do homework to dig into your own research project deeply.
This lecture gives you a survey of your field from the social and wide scientific points of view, the methodology of your study, and the way to find the logical approach in your subject. Furthermore, the lecture provides how to develop your research into business development in relation to intellectual property rights and entrepreneurship.
